title: An acid solution with pH near seven
promptMarkdown: An ideal fully dissociated monoprotic acid is present at $C=1.00\times10^{-8}\,\mathrm M$ at $25^\circ\mathrm C$. Derive $h=(C+\sqrt{C^2+4K_w})/2$ from charge balance and water equilibrium. Compute its pH. Explain precisely why the naive result pH $=8$ is impossible for this model, and find the limits as $C/\sqrt{K_w}$ tends to zero and to infinity.
hintLadder: Treat the fully dissociated acid anion as a fixed negative charge.
The missing positive charge must balance both that anion and hydroxide.
Expand the square root using the dominant scale in each limit.

criteria.criterion: Derives the positive root from charge and water balances.
